office_does: The Coroner investigates deaths in Mason County and works with families of the deceased.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Coroner Jaime Taylor (Prefers Democratic Party), first elected in 2022, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Mason County Coroner, nationally certified medicolegal death investigator with more than 18 years in death investigation; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Board-certified by the American Board of Medicolegal Death Investigators [S1]
Completing a four-year elected term after prior appointed experience [S1]
